title: Geologic map of the St. Matthews quadrangle, Calhoun County, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2014, Geologic map of the St. Matthews quadrangle, Calhoun County, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-211, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single map sheet read from OCR (page 1). Map symbols recorded where on the same line as the unit name (dg, me) or printed directly below or within a description (Qe, Qal, PEodb, PEwh; flagged inferred). OCR-garbled symbols ('~QHiw' for the swamp deposits, '[Pris |' for the Lang Syne, 'UKs' for the Cretaceous) were not recorded. The Water map unit was not recorded. The correlation chart shows unconformities between the Pliocene?, Eocene, Paleocene and Upper Cretaceous units; its unit order is partly garbled in OCR. Map graphics are not readable.
SUBSURFACE: Upper Cretaceous maximum drilled thickness 30 feet (page 1). SCGS drill holes are plotted with log identification numbers (e.g. 09-314); the logs are on file at the SCGS and are not in this document (page 1). Correlation chart with unconformity-bounded units, Upper Cretaceous to Holocene (page 1). No cross sections or structure contours appear in the OCR text. Datum: horizontal 1927 North American Datum; topographic contour interval 3 meters on the 1986 base map; the vertical datum is not stated (page 1).
Re-read of page 1 for subsurface fields (single OCR map sheet; map graphics not readable in the OCR). Units as before; map symbols read from the legend boxes on page-image tiles (OCR had '~QHiw', '[Pris |', 'UKs' garbled or loose). Thicknesses with '|' for the first digit read as 1 (inferred). Correlation chart shows unconformities between the Pliocene?, Eocene, Paleocene and Upper Cretaceous units. Upper Cretaceous maximum drilled thickness 30 feet is a thickness, not a surface. Whole-page image checked: no cross section, structure contours or stated unit-top elevations; SCGS drill holes (09-xxx) plotted by label only, without depths (logs on file at SCGS). Water unit and legend-only symbols not recorded.
